## Objective

- Build a reproducible research system for World Cup market prediction.
- Aggregate prediction market prices, bookmaker odds, and football statistics.
- Produce calibrated probabilities and backtested expected-value signals.

## Why Research-First

- Avoid premature automation risk.
- Validate assumptions using leakage-safe backtests.
- Focus on calibration, reliability, and risk controls.

## Data Architecture

- Bronze: raw market and stats snapshots.
- Silver: normalized entities, aligned timestamps.
- Gold: model-ready features and backtest outputs.

## Source Strategy

- Prediction markets: Polymarket Gamma/CLOB metadata and quotes.
- Bookmaker odds: hybrid strategy with optional The Odds API/API-Football.
- Stats: soccerdata connectors (FBref/Understat-compatible workflows).

## Modeling Stack

- Baseline: Poisson/Elo-informed features.
- Mid-complexity: gradient boosting classifier for selected targets.
- Calibration: reliability diagnostics with Brier/log loss tracking.

## Backtesting

- Time-aware validation windows.
- Edge thresholding against implied probabilities.
- Bankroll controls with capped fractional Kelly policy.

## Dashboard Outputs

- Equity curve and drawdown.
- Attribution by market type and team/stage.
- Signal confidence vs market-implied probability.

## Next Iterations

- Add explicit 1X2 and outright target pipelines.
- Improve feature coverage (travel, rest, injuries, xG depth).
- Add model monitoring and weekly artifact publication.
